chapterInfo.content:
22
Elifas, ahonu ho afotuo
1Ɛnna Temanni Elifas buaa sɛ:
2Ɔdasani bi bɛtumi adi mu wɔ Onyankopɔn anim anaa?
Hwɛ, onimdefoɔ mpo, ɔdi mu wɔ n’ankasa n’ani so.
3Otumfoɔ nya ho biribi sɛ wotene,
anaasɛ ɔnya mfasoɔ sɛ w’akwan di mu?
4Wo suro nti na ɔbɛka w’anim,
na ɔde wo akɔ atemmuo mu anaa?
5Ɛnyɛ sɛ wo bɔne dɔɔso?
Na w’amumuyɛ nni awieeɛ.
6 # Hiob 24.9-10; Eks 22.25-26; Yes 58.7 Sɛ woagye wo nuanom awowa ɔkwa,
na woapa adagyafoɔ ho ntoma.
7 # Mat 25.42-43 Woamma opititɔfoɔ nsuo annom,
na woakame deɛ ɔdi kɔm aduane.
8Na onipa a ne basa mu yɛ den no, ɔno na asase wɔ no,
na deɛ ɔwɔ animuonyam no na ɔtena soɔ.
9 # Hiob 29.12 Woama mmaa akunafoɔ de nsapan kɔ,
na nwisiaa abasa nso, wɔabubu.
10Enti na afidie atwa wo ho ahyia,
na nketenkete yi wo hu mpofirim.
11Anaasɛ wonhunu sum
ne nsuo pii a akata wo soɔ?
12Ɛnyɛ ɔsoro korɔn mu na Onyankopɔn wɔ?
Na hwɛ nsoromma a ɛwɔ sorosoro no sɛdeɛ ɛkorɔn fa!
13Na woka sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na Onyankopɔn nim?
Esum kabii akyiri nohoa na ɔbɛbu atɛn?
14Mununkum yɛ no nkataho, na ɔnhunu adeɛ,
na ɔsoro kɔntɔnkrɔn so na ɔnanteɛ.
15Wobɛfa tete tempɔn no
a mma busufoɔ nantee soɔ no so anaa?
16 # Hiob 15.32-33; Gye 7.21 Wɔn a wɔpraa wɔn kɔeɛ ansa na ɛberɛ reduro,
na wɔn nnyinasoɔ sene kɔɔ sɛ asuo no.
17 # Hiob 21.14 Wɔn na wɔka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ: Firi yɛn so!
Na ɛdeɛn nso na Otumfoɔ bɛyɛ wɔn?
18 # Hiob 21.16 Nanso ɔde nnepa hyehyɛɛ wɔn afie amaama
na abɔnefoɔ agyinatuo mpare me!
19 # Dwom 107.42 Ateneneefoɔ hunu, na wɔn ani gye;
na deɛ ɔdi bem no di wɔn ho fɛw,
20ka sɛ: Ampa ara, wɔn a wɔsɔre tiaa yɛn no ayera,
na wɔn nnikaeɛ no, ogya ahye!
21Fa wo ho bɔ Nyankopɔn ho ɛ, na wo ho nnwo wo;
yei mu na adepa bɛba ama woɔ.
22Gye n’anomu mmara,
na fa ne nsɛm sie w’akomam.
23 # Hiob 8.5-7; 11.14-19 Sɛ wosane kɔ Otumfoɔ nkyɛn a, wɔde wo bɛsi hɔ,
sɛ woyi wo ntomadan mu abusudeɛ kɔ akyirikyiri a, —
24 # 1 Ah 9.28 fa sika amapa gu mfuturo mu,
na Ofir sika nso, fa gu asubɔnten mu mmoseaa mu.
25Na Otumfoɔ bɛyɛ wo sika amapa bebree
ne dwetɛ a wɔahɔre ama woɔ.
26 # Dwom 37.4 Ɛno na wo ho bɛsɛpɛ wo Otumfoɔ ho,
na woama w’ani so akyerɛ Onyankopɔn.
27 # Dwom 50.14-15 Wobɛsrɛ no, na watie wo,
na w’aboadeɛ ka no, woatua.
28Wobɛbɔ wo tirim, na ɛbɛgyina ama wo,
na hann bɛhyerɛn w’akwan so.
29 # 1 Pe 5.5 Sɛ wɔbrɛ wo ase a, ɛno deɛ, ahomasoɔ ntira.
Ɛfiri sɛ ɔhobrɛaseni deɛ, ɔbɛma no adi yie.
30 # Dwom 18.20, 24 Sɛ deɛ ɔnnii bem mpo, ɔbɛgye no a,
ɛnneɛ w’ahoteɛ so na wɔbɛgye wo.

Ɛnna Temanni Elifas buaa sɛ:
Ɔdasani bi bɛtumi adi mu wɔ Onyankopɔn anim anaa?
Hwɛ, onimdefoɔ mpo, ɔdi mu wɔ n’ankasa n’ani so.
Otumfoɔ nya ho biribi sɛ wotene,
anaasɛ ɔnya mfasoɔ sɛ w’akwan di mu?
Wo suro nti na ɔbɛka w’anim,
na ɔde wo akɔ atemmuo mu anaa?
Ɛnyɛ sɛ wo bɔne dɔɔso?
Na w’amumuyɛ nni awieeɛ.
Sɛ woagye wo nuanom awowa ɔkwa,
na woapa adagyafoɔ ho ntoma.
Woamma opititɔfoɔ nsuo annom,
na woakame deɛ ɔdi kɔm aduane.
Na onipa a ne basa mu yɛ den no, ɔno na asase wɔ no,
na deɛ ɔwɔ animuonyam no na ɔtena soɔ.
Woama mmaa akunafoɔ de nsapan kɔ,
na nwisiaa abasa nso, wɔabubu.
Enti na afidie atwa wo ho ahyia,
na nketenkete yi wo hu mpofirim.
Anaasɛ wonhunu sum
ne nsuo pii a akata wo soɔ?

Ɛnyɛ ɔsoro korɔn mu na Onyankopɔn wɔ?
Na hwɛ nsoromma a ɛwɔ sorosoro no sɛdeɛ ɛkorɔn fa!
Na woka sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na Onyankopɔn nim?
Esum kabii akyiri nohoa na ɔbɛbu atɛn?
Mununkum yɛ no nkataho, na ɔnhunu adeɛ,
na ɔsoro kɔntɔnkrɔn so na ɔnanteɛ.
Wobɛfa tete tempɔn no
a mma busufoɔ nantee soɔ no so anaa?
Wɔn a wɔpraa wɔn kɔeɛ ansa na ɛberɛ reduro,
na wɔn nnyinasoɔ sene kɔɔ sɛ asuo no.
Wɔn na wɔka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ: Firi yɛn so!
Na ɛdeɛn nso na Otumfoɔ bɛyɛ wɔn?
Nanso ɔde nnepa hyehyɛɛ wɔn afie amaama
na abɔnefoɔ agyinatuo mpare me!
Ateneneefoɔ hunu, na wɔn ani gye;
na deɛ ɔdi bem no di wɔn ho fɛw,
ka sɛ: Ampa ara, wɔn a wɔsɔre tiaa yɛn no ayera,
na wɔn nnikaeɛ no, ogya ahye!

Fa wo ho bɔ Nyankopɔn ho ɛ, na wo ho nnwo wo;
yei mu na adepa bɛba ama woɔ.
Gye n’anomu mmara,
na fa ne nsɛm sie w’akomam.
Sɛ wosane kɔ Otumfoɔ nkyɛn a, wɔde wo bɛsi hɔ,
sɛ woyi wo ntomadan mu abusudeɛ kɔ akyirikyiri a, —
fa sika amapa gu mfuturo mu,
na Ofir sika nso, fa gu asubɔnten mu mmoseaa mu.
Na Otumfoɔ bɛyɛ wo sika amapa bebree
ne dwetɛ a wɔahɔre ama woɔ.
Ɛno na wo ho bɛsɛpɛ wo Otumfoɔ ho,
na woama w’ani so akyerɛ Onyankopɔn.
Wobɛsrɛ no, na watie wo,
na w’aboadeɛ ka no, woatua.
Wobɛbɔ wo tirim, na ɛbɛgyina ama wo,
na hann bɛhyerɛn w’akwan so.
Sɛ wɔbrɛ wo ase a, ɛno deɛ, ahomasoɔ ntira.
Ɛfiri sɛ ɔhobrɛaseni deɛ, ɔbɛma no adi yie.
Sɛ deɛ ɔnnii bem mpo, ɔbɛgye no a,
ɛnneɛ w’ahoteɛ so na wɔbɛgye wo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
